Every category on the [[Projects|occupation map]] is open for discussion. Bring a spec, a use case, or a grudge.

<span id="how"></span>
== How ==

# Check the [[Projects|map]] and the open issues to see whether the target is already proposed.
# [https://github.com/occupysaas/website/issues/new?title=Target%20proposal%3A%20 Open a target proposal issue] on the website repository, with the title starting “Target proposal:”.
# Answer the questions below in the issue.
# Discuss it in the issue and on [https://discord.gg/jZYA3r27tG Discord]. Targets are picked in public.

<span id="what-to-include"></span>
== What to include ==

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Question
! Why it matters
|-
| Which product or category, and who pays per seat today?
| Shows the pain and the audience
|-
| What public documentation, standards and RFCs describe its interfaces?
| A clean room needs enough public material to write a spec
|-
| Which public client SDKs and CLIs could be tested against our server?
| Compatibility tests decide what counts as done
|-
| Is there a drop-in story: which existing code should work unchanged?
| Defines the scope
|-
| Are you free of confidential knowledge about the product?
| See [[Rules of the road]]
|-
| Who would use it, and who would help build it?
| A project needs people
|}
